class.name: GodotSociDatabase
class.brief_description: Native synchronous SQLite and PostgreSQL database connection. Do not block gameplay frames.
class.description: Native synchronous SQLite and PostgreSQL database connection. Do not block gameplay frames. See res://addons/godot_soci/docs/API.md for usage examples, threading limitations and failure handling.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens one SQLite or PostgreSQL session. Connection can block.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the session and rolls back an outstanding explicit transaction.

method.name: is_open
method.description: True if the session is connected.

method.name: get_last_error_details
method.description: Copied structured diagnostics: error, error_category, backend, backend_error_code and sqlstate. Successful operations clear diagnostics; close preserves them. Capture before rollback. Metadata does not establish transaction outcome or authorize automatic retry.

method.name: execute
method.description: Executes parameterized non-row-returning SQL; returns ok, error and affected_rows.

method.name: query
method.description: Queries at most max_rows rows; returns ok, error, rows and truncated.

method.name: begin_immediate
method.description: Starts SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; SQLite only.

method.name: rollback
method.description: Rolls back the current SQL transaction.

method.name: in_transaction
method.description: Whether the explicit transaction API considers a transaction active.
